description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, Railway Brawler triggers, putting +1/+1 counter(s) on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Railway Brawler triggers, putting +1/+1 counter(s) on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reyhan triggers, putting +1/+1 counter(s) on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 5
